title: Provisional Patent Application 64/157,915: Deterministic Constitutional Autonomous Infrastructure Systems and Methods (Specification as Filed)
description:

Audit ledger and correction receipts: github.com/LLong2026/squirrel-os-lindy-test. Specification of US Provisional Patent Application 64/157,915, filed September 18, 2026 (Patent Center #81949126, Confirmation #1786), first named inventor Leon C Long. Published as timestamped prior art per the open-book disclosure doctrine: receipt first, then publish.

Scope: a single linked inventive concept — Claims 1-5, the Deterministic Runtime Pipeline governing probabilistic agent execution under deterministic invariants (semantic creation, canonicalization, envelope generation, pre-ingestion validation, continuity substrate, universal bridge, healing loop, post-movement validation), and Claim 6, the Method of Construction and Operation of Constitutional Autonomous Infrastructure (substrate provisioning, cage construction, bifurcated operation, chaos-training, mesh feedback, hypervisor supervision, template instantiation, platform adaptation).

Cross-referenced provisionals: 64/119,191; 64/114,746; 64/094,360; 64/082,606; 64/081,911; 64/081,490; 64/145,825. This filing brings the portfolio to 8 patents pending + 5 SBIR tracks.

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects.
